title: UAPI stability: key_fd < -1 not rejected in INIT
description: crypto2dev_init_op.key_fd is documented as 'reserved; must be -1', but ioctl_init (crypto2dev_fd.c:641) only branches on key_fd >= 0. Values < -1 (e.g. -2, -42) silently pass through without error. This is an ABI liability: if a future kernel version assigns meaning to key_fd == -2, existing userspace binaries that accidentally pass -2 (e.g. from an uninitialized struct) will silently get the new behavior. Fix: add an explicit check after the copy_from_user in ioctl_init — if (op.key_fd < -1) return -EINVAL; — before the key_fd >= 0 branch. Compare to DO_KDF which correctly rejects ikm_fd \!= -1 (line 1728) rather than only acting on ikm_fd >= 0.
